title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.13896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. F

translated_title: 神经语义解析的结构自动机
translated_abstract: 神经语义解析器逐token地生成意义表示，然而其良构性取决于在生成过程中逐步展开的指称、辖域和图关系。受限解码可以防止局部无效的token，但无法保证一个有效前缀能够在固定的输出长度限制内被补全。我们在DRS解析的三个阶段（解码、事后处理和训练）研究结构自动机，并额外在AMR上评估了解码方法。对于解码，我们提出了接受路径解码（APD），它在剩余长度限制内维护一个已验证的补全方案，并且只要模型偏好的token同样可以被补全，就遵循该token。APD保证产出一个被接受的结果，且无需回退token。在严格的长度限制下，与局部掩蔽相比，它在DRS上将Smatch++分别提升了5.1和2.4分，在AMR上提升了6.4和3.2分，与在相同限制下需要回退token的回滚方法性能相当。
tldr: 提出基于结构自动机的接受路径解码（APD）方法，可在固定长度限制内保证神经语义解析器生成良构的意义表示，且无需回退token，在DRS和AMR解析上显著优于局部掩蔽方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces accepting-path decoding (APD), a structural automaton-based decoding method that guarantees well-formed meaning representations within fixed length limits without retracting tokens, improving Smatch++ by up to 6.4 points over local masking on DRS and AMR semantic parsing.
